universe.description: small-cap sympathy plays in hot sectors

setup.rule: identify main runner in sector then short sympathy plays when main reverses
setup.quote: my strategy is find the main stock that's running and short their sympathies when the main one starts to reverse

entry.rule: short hard on reversal confirmation of main stock
entry.quote: when Sino starts to reverse I hit a different sympathy hard I short it as hard as I can

stop.rule: cut when main thesis breaks or pain too high
stop.quote: if I'm wrong if sio starts to reverse I'm just going to take my loss

exits.rule: hold 2-3 days for bleed after hype ends
exits.quote: when they do reverse I plan on holding maybe two or three days

sizing.rule: scale in feelers then add on way down with larger account
sizing.quote: with bigger account I guess I have the leeway to short a little bit early to throw out some feelers into parabolics or throw out some feelers into bigger uh bigger size charts and slowly add on the way down

market_filter.rule: hot sectors with chat room/Twitter attention and low float sympathy
market_filter.quote: when they start to have these sympathy plays in the similar sectors that every single person is talking about
